name: PineconeMC 11.0.3-pre1
body:
See Prism Launcher changelogs:
<https://github.com/PrismLauncher/PrismLauncher/releases/tag/11.0.3-pre1>

PineconeMC changes:
- Added Shenandoah garbage collector preset. Shenandoah is a concurrent garbage collector which may perform better than ZGC on small heaps and weak CPUs
- The maximum default memory allocation has been increased to 6 GB
- The default garbage collector preset will be Shenandoah if the memory allocation is less than 4 GB
- Added ability to disable automatic server switching (Settings > Services)
- Fixed an issue that caused libraries to be deleted during automatic server switching
- Fixed an issue that caused translations to break during automatic server switching
- Added ability to fetch CurseForge key from the official launcher, unlocking direct downloads for previously blocked mods and modpacks (Settings > Services)
- Fixed incorrect icon on macOS (thanks @so5iso4ka)
- Added ability to disable the Cat Button in the main window (Settings > Appearance)
- Using the `Launch Offline` button will now skip account refreshing entirely
- Added PineconeMC icon to instance icons

**Flatpak users can install the launcher and its repository with this command (add `--user` if needed): `flatpak install https://elyprismlauncher.github.io/flatpak/elyprismlauncher.flatpakref`)**

## Please read the FAQ before asking any questions: https://pineconemc.ru#faq (alternative URL: https://elyprismlauncher.github.io#faq)

name: PineconeMC 11.0.0
body:
See Prism Launcher changelogs:
<https://github.com/PrismLauncher/PrismLauncher/releases/tag/11.0.0>

PineconeMC changes:
- HTTP/2 is now disabled on all requests, this should improve error message readability and connection stability
- *[since pre2]* The launcher will now automatically determine your connectivity to `pineconemc.ru` and will use the GitHub mirrors if needed. This process is transparent to the user. If connectivity restores, the launcher will switch back. This means some users will no longer have to manually switch meta servers and will now have news available
- *[since pre2]* The launcher now automatically supplies Java arguments that improve garbage collection performance. You can look at the supplied arguments or disable this feature in `Settings` -> `Java`
- *[since pre1]* Implemented the first stage of rebranding. Cosmetic changes were performed in the launcher UI. If we missed something, please report it.
- *[since pre1]* This release updates GitHub URLs to allow for a smooth transition via automatic redirects. Thus it is *very important* that you update to this release to continue receive updates.

**If you're not sure what to download on Windows, click `PineconeMC-Windows-MSVC-Setup-11.0.0.exe`**

**Flatpak users can install the launcher and its repository with this command (add `--user` if needed): `flatpak install https://elyprismlauncher.github.io/flatpak/elyprismlauncher.flatpakref`)**

name: ElyPrismLauncher 10.0.0
body:
See Prism Launcher changelogs:
[10.0.0](https://github.com/PrismLauncher/PrismLauncher/releases/tag/10.0.0)

### Changes

* Integrated ElyPrismLauncher metadata with Prism's metadata format and handling (https://github.com/ElyPrismLauncher/ElyPrismLauncher/issues/70).
  * This means that metadata will be fetched more reliably and will be cached
  * This requires that EPL's meta server is in use. Using other meta servers will result in launches failing until Ely patching is disabled
* Because metadata is cached, Ely patches can now be applied even when launching offline, provided the instance has already been launched at least once online with version 10.0.0.
* The Flatpak build now uses `io.github.elyprismlauncher.ElyPrismLauncher` as its ID, instead of Prism's

### Fixes

* Fixed skins not being present in very old versions (https://github.com/ElyPrismLauncher/ElyPrismLauncher/issues/66, https://github.com/ElyPrismLauncher/ElyPrismLauncher/commit/eefe0375af0b8be810781952cffe9368db1cec53)
* Fixed some branding being incorrect (https://github.com/ElyPrismLauncher/ElyPrismLauncher/issues/73)
* Disallowed entering invalid characters in username unless explicitly overriden (https://github.com/ElyPrismLauncher/ElyPrismLauncher/issues/80)

**If you're not sure what to download on Windows, click `ElyPrismLauncher-Windows-MSVC-Setup-10.0.0.exe`**
**Arch Linux users can download `ElyPrismLauncher-ArchLinux-x86_64-10.0.0.pkg.tar.zst` and install it with `pacman -U`**

name: ElyPrismLauncher 9.5
body:
**This release is based on Prism Launcher 9.4**

## Fixes
- Ely.by Authlibs are now stored separately from Mojang Authlibs. This fixes an issue where it was impossible to use a Mojang Authlib after a Ely.by Authlib has already been downloaded. If you encountered this issue, delete your `libraries` folder.
  - This also reduces launch time and network bandwidth spent
- Fixed a possible bug where the game would attempt loading `authlib-injector` even if the launcher was unable to fetch `authlib-injector`
- Fixed an issue that caused the launcher to fetch `authlib-injector` even when Ely.by patching wasn't wanted

If you have any issues or questions, join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/5kcBCvnbTp) or open a new [GitHub issue](https://github.com/ElyPrismLauncher/ElyPrismLauncher/issues/new/choose)

name: ElyPrismLauncher 9.1
body:
See PrismLauncher changelogs:
[9.0](https://github.com/PrismLauncher/PrismLauncher/releases/tag/9.0)
[9.1](https://github.com/PrismLauncher/PrismLauncher/releases/tag/9.1)

## New features in ElyPrismLauncher
- Modern and secure login: ElyPrismLauncher now uses OAuth2 to log you in. This means that your credentials are never transferred to the launcher. Instead, you log into your account on the official Ely.by page in the browser, and Ely.by gives the launcher a token to access your account with limited privileges.
- Skins support on servers: ElyPrismLauncher now uses Ely.by's official Authlib patches, allowing you to see skins anywhere


## Important notes
- ElyPrismLauncher now has it's own branding (thanks @mctaylors!)
- Due to changes in the account list format made in Prism Launcher 9.1, you will have to re-add your Ely.by accounts
- ElyPrismLauncher now uses it's own data directory, separate from Prism Launcher. You will be offered an option to migrate data on first startup.

If you have any issues or questions, join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/5kcBCvnbTp) or open a new [GitHub issue](https://github.com/Octol1ttle/ElyPrismLauncher/issues/new/choose)
